note: Frozen BEFORE any source fetch. Pre-flight DNS/TCP/TLS reachability diagnostics (no content fetched, no bytes persisted) were run to verify the environment could reach the candidate surface at all; all later fetches, probes and evidence follow THIS manifest.
pairs_note: Exactly these 5; no other symbol; no XAUUSD. URL symbol form candidate: lowercase, no separator.
candidate_url_patterns_to_verify_from_by: License/terms pages: official dukascopy.com domains only (www.dukascopy.com and subdomains); pages must be hashed; verbatim operative clauses recorded
forbidden_sources: third-party mirrors/aggregators as source of data or licensing claims

dst_transition_window.transition_utc: 2026-03-08T07:00:00Z (US DST start; 2nd Sunday of March 2026; 02:00 America/New_York EST->EDT)
dst_transition_window.fetch_rule: hourly files 2026-03-07 20:00 UTC through 2026-03-09 00:00 UTC inclusive (29 hourly files per pair) where surface is hourly-partitioned; if day-granular, fetch 2026-03-07 and 2026-03-08 day files

availability_head_census.grid_definition: h1 Wed-of-DST-week 13:00 UTC (active); h2 same Wed 03:00 UTC (quiet Asia); h3 DST-transition Sunday 06:00 UTC (pre-transition weekend); h4 DST-transition Sunday 07:00 UTC (DST boundary instant); h5 DST-transition Sunday 21:00 UTC (first candidate open hour, EDT 17:00); h6 DST-transition Sunday 22:00 UTC (populated open hour); h7 September Friday 20:00 UTC (active pre-close); h8 September Friday 21:00 UTC (Friday-close hour, 17:00 EDT)
availability_head_census.cap_formula: 5 x (5 pairs x 5 years x 8 hours)

census_etiquette_frozen.sequencing: sequential, >= 1 s spacing between any two requests
census_etiquette_frozen.retries: <= 2 retries with exponential backoff per probe
census_etiquette_frozen.escalation_rule: any 4XX/5XX/reset pattern is EVIDENCE, never a reason to escalate request volume

byte_cap.accounting: cumulative response-body bytes of every successful GET, tracked after every fetch; a fetch is refused (never started/persisted) if its declared Content-Length would breach the remaining headroom

raw_layout.meta_artifacts: <root>/_meta/<category>/... (license page snapshots, DNS evidence, control probes) — documented extension for non-pair artifacts

fetch_order_frozen: 1. transport-verification probes (pattern HEAD/GET pair + control probes)
4. DST-transition window GETs (smallest expected bytes first)
7. determinism re-fetch of >= 5 already-fetched files (sha256 ALL_MATCH required)

determinism_check.rule: sha256 ALL_MATCH required; byte variation is recorded as MISMATCH = FAIL evidence, never normalized

two_sided_quote_proof_required.decoder: decode_bi5.py committed in lane dir, run via workspace .venv
must_prove: stride consistency from raw sizes (test 20; reject others only with evidence)
BOTH ask and bid present per record; counts of bid>ask, bid==ask
ms-offset + file-hour = as-served time; UTC convention verified against quiet vs active hours
